# Repository instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before making changes. It is the authoritative repository-wide policy for content eligibility, source attribution, classification, canonical deduplication, Markdown rendering, scripts and acceptance tests.

In particular: do not collect prompt-free utility operations such as background or person removal; group reference generation and prompt-driven editing under reference/; retain one canonical case per original post or identical normalized full prompt; edit input data/scripts rather than generated Markdown; use upstream images only; check third-party rights and run npm run check for code/content changes. Do not claim unrun checks passed.
